business_problem: give customer-facing and analytics teams faster natural-language access to global commerce data so they can spot conversion and renewal opportunities without constant SQL help from engineers.
solution_summary: Cleverbridge uses Snowflake, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, and Cortex Search on Snowflake to give customer-facing and analytics teams faster natural-language access to global commerce data so they can spot conversion and renewal opportunities without constant SQL help from engineers. Payment, checkout, conversion, and renewal data are centralized in Snowflake so customer-success, revenue, and analytics teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Cortex AI adds in-platform LLM and agentic capabilities for classification, summarization, retrieval, or natural-language analytics on top of the curated data foundation. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Cleverbridge achieved 13–21 Months saved developing agentic capabilities with Cortex AI and 33% Faster time to insight.
